notes.title: On Track is part of the Back To School Games Celebration!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We love how much everyone is enjoying the game and we're hard at work behind the scenes fixing bugs and creating new content for everyone. We wanted to share that On Track is part of the Back To School Games Celebration that started August 26th. Go check out all the awesome educational and productivity games! 

If you have any suggestions or bugs be sure to drop them in discord or in the forums and we'll get right on it!

As we mentioned in a previous update we're publishing a good friend's game coming out August 29th. If you love chill puzzle games that make you think be sure to check them out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844790/Dungeon_Divers/

Thanks for taking the time to read our post.

Until next time, stay on track!

notes.title: The Designer Update Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Just pushing a minor hotfix to a few errors we needed to fix on the backend. We also enabled the stats screen in the main menu under settings. Right now it's just tracking how many hours/minutes you've worked but for those of you who are reporting issues with the 80 hours achievement please let us know

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed some minor backend errors
[*] Added stats menu to main menu under settings, currently only tracking time worked in hours/minutes.
[*] Removed borderless until more permanent fix can be found for issues reported.
[/list]

If you have any further issues please post in the Steam forums or join the discord. 

Until next time, take care!

notes.title: The Designer Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

We hope you're enjoying the game and getting stuff done in a cozy setting. We're happy to announce we've got a new update to share with everyone. We've added a few new features, fixes, and some additional content. We're still hard at work improving the game and we have some stuff that's not quite ready to show coming up but we hope you enjoy the new stuff. 

We've also heard everyone's request for a way to support the game and we're happy to also announce we've made a small Support The Devs DLC. It's a small cosmetic DLC that adds a coffee/tea cup to your train car. 

You can check it out below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3082800/On_Track__Support_The_Devs__Buy_Us_a_Coffee_Get_a_Coffee/

On to the patch notes!

[b]FIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor texture issues
[*] Improved optimization (This is still on-going)
[*] Minor game adjustments with clipping objects
[/list]

[b]ADDITIONS[/b]
[list]
[*] New designer menu with color picker options and hexcode support
[*] [strike]Added new borderless window option in main menu[/strike] Removed until more permanent fix is devised. Too many issues at present.
[*] Added 10 new songs to tracklist
[list]
[*]      Luke Holizna - A Soul Full Of Memories
[*]      Luke Holizna - Analog
[*]      Luke Holizna - Childhood
[*]      Luke Holizna - Down Time
[*]      Luke Holizna - Introvert 
[*]      Luke Holizna - Player 2
[*]      Luke Holizna - Tapping On The Roof
[*]      Luke Holizna - The Best Of Times
[*]      Luke Holizna - Too Many Thoughts
[*]      Luke Holizna - We Were Kids 
[/list]
[/list]
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor issues with borderless mode when quickly changing display modes. Can be fixed by switching resolutions but working on a more robust fix. 
[/list]

We've also attached some sample color schemes that we think you'll all really like but we can't wait to see what people share. Just punch these hexcodes into the color picker and you should have the same exact scheme!

notes.title: On Track is part of the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We love how much everyone is enjoying the game and we're hard at work behind the scenes fixing bugs and creating new content for everyone. We wanted to share that On Track will be part of the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration starting August 15th. 

We're working on some additional customization and some more music for the player. We're also research spotify integration as well as custom music so we'll have some more news on that soon. If you have any suggestions or bugs be sure to drop them in discord or in the forums and we'll get right on it!

In other news we're publishing a good friend's game pretty soon and they have a free prologue coming out next week. If you love chill puzzle games that make you think be sure to check them out.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3108900/Dungeon_Divers_Prologue/

Thanks for taking the time to read our post.

Until next time, stay on track!

notes.title: Release and Patch #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Thanks so much for sharing all the feedback about the game. We're thrilled that so many people are excited about the game and that the reviews have been so positive. So release has been a resounding success, there have been some technical glitches but we've been hard at work at addition more options, squashing bugs that have cropped up and giving you greater flexibility with how you get productive. 

Here's a list of the fixes and changes we've added to the game.

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Restored saving to key bits of the UI such as the clock, train speed, and other options you tweak while playing. 
[*] Achievements should be working correctly. One achievement was having issues firing off correctly but that's been clarified so let us know if you aren't getting it. 
[*] Fixed trees clipping into the train car
[*] Water rendering correctly in Meadows
[*] Added button clicks to buttons that were missing them
[/list]

[h1]ADDITIONS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added V-Sync
[*] New Quality levels so you can tailor your performance
[*] Added the ability to have windowed mode or full screen
[*] Added ability to resolution change
[*] Updated train max speed (Gotta go fast)
[*] New option in the pause menu to reverse the direction of the train
[/list]

Please be sure to leave a review on the game, that helps others find the game! Please leave your bug reports in the forums or on discord so we can knock them out. Thank you again for your feedback!

Hope you have a wonderful weekend and stay on track!

notes.title: On Track Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We're thrilled to finally announce that On Track will release July 31st, 2024! We're excited to get the full game into everyone's hands next week! Watch this space as we have plans for post-launch that we think you're really gonna like. 

If you haven't already please wishlist as that means the world to us and helps so much!
